what_was_done: Audited the topbar controls: chart reload, timeframe, SDCA lab, and ops console are real controls; the missing product surface was Bob's IBKR paper/read-only state.
Reframed the ticker field as optional chart context instead of the primary decision driver; Bob still chooses candidates from open investment questions.
Added a real IBKR broker status chip to the topbar. It reads /health/details and renders IBKR READ, IBKR OFF, or IBKR TRADE based on broker state.
Wired the IBKR chip to open the System Operations Console and refresh broker diagnostics, so it is not decorative.
Added a Broker Link card to the Ops Console with provider, status, mode, equity, and positions from the live mission broker summary.
Updated browser_smoke.py so the UI smoke clicks the IBKR chip and verifies broker status leaves the Checking state.
Fixed Ops Console row wrapping so long GPU/model strings do not overlap neighboring cards.
Added responsive breakpoints for topbar/body/app-main so the new controls remain visible on a 390px mobile viewport without horizontal overflow.
evidence: browser smoke: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/browser_smoke.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8002 --skip-chat --timeout-ms 180000 -> ok=true, chart ticker=AAPL, candleCount=130, canvas nonBlank=378108, console_errors=[].
